# Marathon — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Where did Marathon originate?", "Greece"),
    ("How is Marathon scored?", "fastest time"),
    ("What is origin?", "Greece, 1896 (Olympic)"),
    ("What is players?", "individual"),
    ("What is equipment?", "shoes"),
    ("What is venue?", "42.195 km road"),
    ("What is scoring?", "fastest time"),
    ("What is governing body?", "World Athletics"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
